About the Practice

St. Joseph's Hospital and Medical Center, a Dignity Health hospital in Phoenix, Arizona, is a nationally recognized center for quality care, research, and innovation. For over a century, it has been committed to providing compassionate, patient-centered care. This 576-bed, not-for-profit hospital is a respected center for medical education and research and includes the internationally renowned Barrow Neurological Institute, the Norton Thoracic Institute, Center for Women's Health, the Dignity Health – Cancer Institute, and a Level I Trauma Center. It offers a wide range of medical services and specialties including Heart and Vascular, Lung Disease & Thoracic Disorders, Emergency & Trauma, Orthopedics, Internal Medicine, Primary Care, Organ Transplant, Pediatrics, and more.

Primary Electronic Health Record System

Research Analysis
Methodology & Findings

St. Joseph's Hospital and Medical Center, which is part of Dignity Health, utilizes "My Portal by Dignity Health" as its patient portal. This patient portal allows patients to access their medical information, view lab results, manage appointments, and communicate with their healthcare team. Dignity Health has a contract with Cerner Corporation to provide patients with access to certain electronic health information through the My Portal platform. This indicates that the EHR system used by Dignity Health, and consequently St. Joseph's Hospital and Medical Center, is Cerner.
